_comment: Real board-125 children, captured from the live board on 2026-09-13 via
number/title/state are verbatim. Each child's body is its real `## Repo`
declaration block as it appears on the live board, which is the pattern this
fixture exists to pin; the live bodies additionally carry a legacy
`Parent: #125` line and a `## Finding summary` section, which are covered by
that check's own tests and are deliberately not repeated here so this
fixture's count isolates the `foreign-repo-declaration` check. Issue #125
(the epic) carries its real `## Scope` section, so the fixture also proves
the epic itself is never flagged.
States are as on the live board: #130 is CLOSED (resolved history, not a
finding); the other twelve children are open; #125 is open.

items.title: EPIC: CMR vendor compliance remediation backlog (all violators)
items.body:
## Scope
Close the bi-directional vendor compliance gaps across the CMR fleet: governance drift, onboarding gate failures, missing guardrails, missing Dependabot, missing branch protection, and module dependency pin drift.
